dialogues.speaker: Ruiqun
dialogues.text: See, I knew at once that you were someone of unimpeachable character. No wonder you raised a heroine as virtuous as Ms. Shenhe!

dialogues.speaker: Xiaokang
dialogues.text: Were it not for her intervention, those "tour group" fraudsters would have cut and run with the money my child paid them!

dialogues.speaker: Lishan
dialogues.text: I'd been planning to register my old man — y'know, to give him the holiday he's never managed to enjoy all these years... To think it was all a scam!

dialogues.speaker: Ruiqun
dialogues.text: Exactly! And you know that pamphlet? Apparently, it's all fake! The so-called suites are just some hastily built huts. And forget food, there was never even any lard to cook with!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: What!? To shamelessly exploit the filial spirit of our youth for their vile and base ends... One shall... One shall show them no mercy!

dialogues.speaker: Xiaokang
dialogues.text: C—Calm down, ma'am... The group's boss has already turned himself in to the Millelith. He was all black and blue when he returned me my money...

dialogues.speaker: Ruiqun
dialogues.text: If he hadn't constantly implored us to beg the white-haired heroine who works at Wanmin Restaurant for mercy, we wouldn't even have known it was Ms. Shenhe who secretly aided us!

dialogues.speaker: Ruiqun
dialogues.text: That's why we're here to thank you in person!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Oh? Did Shenhe already discover the truth, and...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Ahem. Noble deeds are not done for fame. You are all too kind, to come forth in this manner.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaokang
dialogues.text: Wow, virtue really does run in the family! You truly have taught her well!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Shenhe is quiet and one of few words, but she has her own way of conducting herself. As for me, my place is to have faith in her and support her, and influence her decisions as little as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It was she who signed me up with... that senior whatever it was called tour group at first, only to arrange for me to travel abroad herself afterwards instead. Now I see that she had her own plans in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: And that is well. As the youth come into their own, elders such as myself should let go more and let them soar, and learn to enjoy life ourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Xiaokang
dialogues.text: Travel abroad? My, Ms. Shenhe really is a model of filial piety!

dialogues.speaker: Ruiqun
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder if I'll ever be lucky enough to travel like that... How much would that even cost...

dialogues.speaker: Lishan
dialogues.text: I'd love to take my dad out to see the world, too...

dialogues.speaker: Ruiqun
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you give us some advice, Ms. Xianyun? Surely we can't go wrong with a selection from someone of your unique tastes!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Ah, you flatter me. I'm no expert, so what I give cannot be considered guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: That said, should you be interested, I do have a number of experiences and pictures of scenery from my travels, of which I could share a few...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that sure is a crowd... Huh? There's Shenhe! Hey—! Shenhe!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were just listening in. Seems like everyone's here to thank you for busting a fraudulent tour group, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It does sound like it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! ...Hey, wait, then why are they all gathered around her to thank you?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Master's skill in conversation is second to none. It is only natural that she attracts attention.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: In any case, even had I not canceled her registration, she would have taken action upon discovering their tricks once she participated in the tour.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: That's why everyone has gathered around her, and I think... she deserves the respect regardless.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so the reason you were so insistent on canceling the registration back then was because you knew something was up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hah, that's the disciple of an adeptus for you! Perceptive and thorough!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Oh... No, not at all.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: When I sought their boss out to refund my deposit, he rejected my request, drunkenly spilling the beans in the process. Upon seeing that he wouldn't cooperate, I was forced to use my fists instead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... So that's what happened... W—Well, he had it coming, anyway! What goes around comes around!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, all's well that ends well, right? The bad guy gets his just desserts, everyone recouped their losses, and Xianyun had fun!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Speaking of endings, Master's journey seems to have been a pleasant one. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: She bought my fellow disciples and I many local specialties, with a variety of flavors... I had the pleasure of getting a taste of Mondstadt as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, she brought back nothing but food? What did she get? If you can't finish it all, Paimon'll be happy to help, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Windwheel Asters, Cecilias, Calla Lilies... all of which taste better than Qingxin. Would you like any, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Raw? Uhh... Paimon's gonna pass on that. Is your stomach okay?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Yes. Are they inedible? I thought they were like Qingxin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, most people wouldn't even eat Qingxin raw. We usually cook plants before eating them...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I see... In that case, I'll take them over to Wanmin Restaurant later and have Chef Mao study them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And once that research is done, we can enjoy them together.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Yes... Let's do that.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But before that, I have something I wish to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Your return to Liyue Harbor has made Master very happy, and has been a pleasant surprise for me as well... For that, I thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Thanks for stopping by and I look forward to seeing you again soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "See you again soon"? Are you in that much of a hurry to say goodbye?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I heard that the focus of the phrase is on seeing each other once more. Our customers always smile and say that to each other after they finish eating...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: What I mean to say is, I am very much looking forward to seeing you again at the soonest opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's absolutely right. I look forward to seeing you again soon, Shenhe!
